title: Trove environment almanac
description: One line of environment/<source>/almanac/YYYY-MM.jsonl: one day of solar/lunar geometry for a location — sunrise, sunset, twilight stages, day length, moon. Keyed by date (+ rounded lat/lon). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

lat.description: latitude the geometry was computed for, in degrees

lon.description: longitude the geometry was computed for, in degrees

solar_noon.description: RFC3339 local time of solar noon

civil_twilight_begin.description: RFC3339 local time civil twilight begins

civil_twilight_end.description: RFC3339 local time civil twilight ends

nautical_twilight_begin.description: RFC3339 local time nautical twilight begins

nautical_twilight_end.description: RFC3339 local time nautical twilight ends

astronomical_twilight_begin.description: RFC3339 local time astronomical twilight begins

astronomical_twilight_end.description: RFC3339 local time astronomical twilight ends

golden_hour.description: RFC3339 local; start of evening golden hour where the source reports it

extra.description: everything source-specific (illumination fraction, named moon-phase times, …)
